$comment: Ingestion source of truth (SPEC §3). Seeded from docs/research/corpus-viability.md §1. kinds: sinalevi (3-call API, idFichaNorma; vigente version resolved at fetch), hacienda-pdf (Playwright fetch — WAF blocks plain HTTP), cabys (curated dev-relevant subset, task #8), unresolved (official source to locate during ingestion; never ingest secondary commentary). retiredDocKeys names documents that a run must remove from the database before dumping the corpus index; retirementNotes records why. deepLink (#134): audited per source — how deep the official URL can be linked. `articulo` = SINALEVI ficha; the viewer opens one artículo at Informacion?param1=<ficha>&param2=<idVersionNorma>&param3=3&param4=<idArticulo>, and `source.articulos` (artículo number → idArticulo) is harvested at ingestion from the «Ficha Artículo» rail in the full-text payload — _BuscarArticulo answers -1 for our fichas, so the rail is the only mapping. `page` = PDF whose primary text is a page range; the chip appends #page=<first page>. excerpt (#176, #256): from/to line markers bounding the portion an entry claims, after PDF or SINALEVI HTML extraction; ingestion fails loudly if a marker is missing or ambiguous. `none` = the document root is the deepest honest link, with the reason in that entry's notes. imagesAudited (#177): for entries carrying an IMAGE AUDIT note, every SINALEVI image src or PDF page/object identity a human looked at in that audit — ingestion logs a quiet receipt while the payload stays inside this set, and the full warning naming new identities the moment a re-crawl adds one.

documents.title: Ley del Impuesto sobre el Valor Agregado (texto consolidado)
Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta (texto consolidado)
documents.notes: Texto consolidado vigente de la Ley 7092. La ficha ya incorpora la Ley 10818 y sus cifras para 2026: el artículo 8 inciso s) permite a las personas físicas prestadoras de servicios optar por una deducción única del 25 % sin prueba, y el artículo 15 contiene la escala de personas físicas con actividades lucrativas y la regla aplicable cuando también perciben salario. Se ingiere junto a reglamento-renta porque la ley fija la obligación sustantiva y el reglamento su aplicación. Reemplaza por completo a ley-9635 Título II: la ley reformadora omitía con «[…]» los incisos no modificados y duplicaba, además, la Ley del IVA consolidada. Retiro en el mismo cambio #268; todos los objetivos de evaluación se migraron a ley-renta o ley-iva.

documents.title: Reglamento de la Ley del Impuesto sobre el Valor Agregado
documents.notes: IMAGE AUDIT (#150): 5 images, all rendered formulas; 2 lose substance no chunk of THIS document carries. (a) Artículo 31 inciso 4) — the bien-de-capital adjustment (Ca₀ − Caᵢ)/4 is image-only, so the text reads «El ajuste en cada año deberá calcularse utilizando la siguiente fórmula:» straight into «Donde:». (b) The retención percentage %RT = FR × (TM/13%) × 1/(1+TM) is image-only; the prose names every input and says it is deflated to exclude the IVA, but not the composition. The other 3 restate adjacent prose verbatim and lose nothing. GAPS CLOSED ELSEWHERE (#176): both artículos are now also ingested from the Gaceta that published them, as `reglamento-iva-bienes-capital` (artículo 31, from the reform decree 43173-H) and `reglamento-iva-retencion-tarjetas` (artículo 41, from Alcance 129) — each carrying the formula as text. This ficha stays the primary, whole-reglamento source and is unaffected; never cite THESE chunks for either computation, cite the companion entry. Why they are separate entries rather than a replacement: SINALEVI's consolidated vigente text is the only source for the other 72 artículos, and no single Gaceta carries the reglamento as it now reads.

documents.title: Reglamento del IVA, artículo 31 — crédito aplicable respecto a bienes de capital

excerpt.from: Artículo 31.- Crédito aplicable respecto a bienes de capital

documents.notes: Closes gap (a) of the #150 audit — see the reglamento-iva note. La Gaceta 193, Alcance 202 del 2021-10-07, which is where decreto ejecutivo 43173-H del 3 de agosto de 2021 was published: SINALEVI's reform note gives only the number and the decree's own date, and a public search for it keeps surfacing 43143-H, so the publication was found by scanning the alcances of 2021 for the decree number (#176). Its artículo 1° quotes the reformed inciso 4) in full, formula included, as selectable text (pdftotext -layout, no OCR) — and that quotation is word-for-word the vigente inciso 4) in the SINALEVI ficha, which is what makes ingesting the 2021 publication safe where ingesting the 2019 one was not. Excerpted rather than page-ranged (#176): the same two pages carry other incisos this decree reformed, and one of them — «46) Seguros de sobrevivencia» — was renumbered to 49) by decreto 44392 del 15 de noviembre de 2023, so a page-granular range would seat a superseded numbering beside vigente chunks. Rige a partir de su publicación (ARTÍCULO 3), hence the effective_date. Deep link page (#134): chips land on page 17, where the decree's quotation of artículo 31 begins inside the 91-page alcance. FORMULA (#203, was RESIDUE): pdftotext drops the fraction bar — it is drawn, not typed — so the stacked formula used to flatten to «𝐶𝑎0 ‒ 𝐶𝑎𝑖 4», indistinguishable from 𝐶𝑎0 − 𝐶𝑎𝑖 − 4. Remedied: stackedFraction reads the numerator's columns against the denominator's and the chunk now carries «(𝐶𝑎0 ‒ 𝐶𝑎𝑖)/(4)». The #203 survey of every PDF-sourced entry found stacked formulas in exactly two of them, this and reglamento-iva-retencion-tarjetas; the other five (tramos-renta-2026, ccss-escala-ivm, ccss-escala-salud, salarios-minimos, tribu-cr-guia) carry none, and the flag is set only here and there. SURVEY (#199): the excerpted decree is single-column prose — no rail. Not flagged.

documents.title: Reglamento del IVA, artículo 41 — pagos a cuenta y porcentaje de retención (%RT)

excerpt.from: Artículo 41.- Pagos a cuenta del Impuesto Sobre el Valor Agregado
excerpt.to: Artículo 42.- Determinación, liquidación y pago del impuesto

documents.notes: Closes gap (b) of the #150 audit — see the reglamento-iva note. La Gaceta 108, Alcance 129 del 2019-06-11, the original publication of the reglamento, carries both the %RT formula and the tarifa media it depends on as selectable text. Safe to ingest even though the 2019 alcance as a whole is not: artículo 41 carries no reform note in the vigente SINALEVI text, so its wording is unchanged, and the excerpt is bounded to that artículo alone (#176) so no neighbouring 2019 wording comes with it. effective_date is the reglamento's own vigencia, 2019-07-01. Deep link page (#134): chips land on page 75, where artículo 41 begins inside the 106-page alcance. BRACKET TABLE (#242, was RESIDUE): the %RT bracket table has two columns, below what layoutTable (#179) can read, so it survives as a run-on line in the chunk — and one bracket wraps, with pdftotext putting a blank line inside the row, so «90% o menos del 100% de ventas locales, exentas o no sujetas» used to read «…exentas o no 1% sujetas», its rate spliced into the middle of its own condition. Remedied: wrappedRow pulls the stray «sujetas» back onto the row's own line and the chunk now carries «90% o menos del 100% de ventas locales, exentas o no sujetas 1%»; the other four brackets read exactly as they did. The fraction bars are a separate fault, and remedied (#203, was RESIDUE): pdftotext drops them — they are drawn, not typed — so the formula used to flatten to «𝑇𝑀 1 𝑃𝑜𝑟𝑐𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑎𝑗𝑒 𝑑𝑒 𝑟𝑒𝑡𝑒𝑛𝑐𝑖ó𝑛 = 𝐹𝑅 ∗ ∗ 13% 1 + 𝑇𝑀», both numerators hoisted to the front and both denominators pushed to the back. With stackedFraction the chunk carries «𝑃𝑜𝑟𝑐𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑎𝑗𝑒 𝑑𝑒 𝑟𝑒𝑡𝑒𝑛𝑐𝑖ó𝑛 = 𝐹𝑅 ∗ (𝑇𝑀)/(13%) ∗ (1)/(1 + 𝑇𝑀)», and the same page's tarifa media reads «𝑇𝑎𝑟𝑖𝑓𝑎 𝑀𝑒𝑑𝑖𝑎 (𝑇𝑀) = (Total de impuesto repecutido)/(𝑇𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙 𝑑𝑒 𝑣𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑎𝑠 𝑠𝑢𝑗𝑒𝑡𝑎𝑠 𝑦 𝑛𝑜 𝑒𝑥𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑎𝑠)». The denominators «13%» and «1 + 𝑇𝑀» are one space apart, so the reading is only unambiguous because the numerators above them say where the boundary is; a fused row nothing on the page can cut fails ingestion instead of guessing. SURVEY (#199): no rail — the %RT brackets are one line each. The wrapped bracket above was a different fault, one labelRail does not address, and is flagged wrappedRow instead. Not flagged labelRail.

documents.notes: IMAGE AUDIT (#150): 3 images, all rendered formulas, all 3 image-only — the proration rules in TRANSITORIO I («Disposiciones sobre el Transitorio XIX de la Ley 9635»): tramo de renta and crédito fiscal prorated as (valor del periodo ordinario / 12) × meses del periodo, and impuesto determinado re-annualised as (impuesto 2020 / meses del periodo) × 12. Never cite this Transitorio for a computation; the rest of the reglamento is unaffected. SURVEY (#203): out of #203's reach, and recorded here so nobody re-opens it. #203 restores fraction bars that pdftotext drops; this ficha is SINALEVI HTML, so pdftotext never runs on it, and its three formulas are lost as *images* (the IMAGE AUDIT above), not as flattened text. Same verdict as #150's: the rule is spent, and nothing here is worth ingesting a second source for.

The sheet is a bracket table and a créditos rail, not an expression; the only blocks whose ink nests and centres are the three-line title and two of the crédito rows, and none of them carries an equation glyph — which is why the #203 detector gates on that glyph and not on geometry. documents.title: CCSS — Escala contributiva de trabajadores independientes y asegurados voluntarios, Seguro de IVM
documents.norma: Ficha técnica PE-DAE-1179-2025 (acuerdo Junta Directiva, artículo 4°, sesión 9570)
documents.notes: Carries the IVM rates by income bracket (afiliado 4.16–8.42%, conjunta 9.91% + 1.75% Estado como tal = 11.66% global). Brackets are in SM multiples, so they stay correct across wage decrees — resolve colón amounts via salarios-minimos. Adopted verbatim by the Junta Directiva on 2025-12-18 (9 votos en firme) per artículo 33 and Transitorio XI del Reglamento del Seguro de IVM; rige hasta 2028-12-31, next escalón 2029 — re-crawl then. Ingested from the sesión's anexos zip because SINALEVI publishes CCSS escala acuerdos as raster images (#114). Deep link none (#134): the official URL is a zip, so the browser downloads it — no fragment reaches the PDF inside. RAIL (#199): the ficha is a two-column form — a narrow left rail of field names (Tema, Subtema, CONSIDERANDO, PROPUESTAS DE ACUERDO, Técnica, Financiera) beside the body — so joining a block's lines dropped each label into the middle of the sentence next to it, and put «ACUERDO» between two bullets of one list, splitting «Estado (Cuota complementaria)» from «Estado como Tal» — the two concepts #179 exists to keep apart. labelRail re-reads those blocks as «label: body». Two residues a reader should know about: the «Responsable de la presentación» cell swallows the «2. Sinopsis» heading below it, because pdftotext leaves no blank line between them, and «Antecedentes» — whose cell spans a page break — stays a one-word paragraph rather than prefixing the text it labels. IMAGE AUDIT (#175): the gradualidad table this ficha técnica quotes — the salaried patrono/trabajador split behind the 11.66% global, and the 2029 escalón — is a raster image in every primary channel that publishes it, this document included (page 1 of the ficha técnica, a 765×614 JPEG): SINALEVI ficha 26485, the sesión 9038 reform ficha 89493, CCSS's own reglamento PDF, acta 9038 and the official La Gaceta 161 / Alcance 191 del 2019-08-28 all read «…se realizará con la siguiente gradualidad:» straight into the paragraph after the table. Never cite this document for the patrono/trabajador split or the 2029 rate; the independent-worker escala it was ingested for is unaffected. Text-carrying primary source located but NOT ingested: the consulta pública propuesta in La Gaceta 62 del 2019-03-28 sets the whole table out as text, but it is the proposal, not the adopted schedule — it dates the 11.66% escalón 2025-2027 and 12.16% from 2028, where the acuerdo (rige 2020-01-01) put them at 2026-01-01→2028-12-31 and 2029-01-01. See corpus-viability §1 and #175 for the evidence. TABLE EXTRACTION (#179): the escala's own table is column-aligned text, and joining its lines into a paragraph fused «Estado» and «Art. 78» into one header label and dropped the alignment, so categories 2–5 (no Art. 78 cell) read as three values where category 1 has four — the shape a reader turns into an extra Estado contribution on top of the conjunta. `layoutTable` records the column labels a reader of the PDF sees; extraction re-emits each category as its own labelled row, and fails loudly if CCSS re-publishes the ficha with a different grid. The conjunta is the sum of the columns beside it (4.16 + 5.45 + 0.30 = 9.91), not a further charge on top of them — the document never says so in words, so an answer must read it off the row. SURVEY (#203): no stacked formula — the ficha states the contribution percentages as a table and as prose, and computes nothing. Not flagged.

documents.title: CCSS — Escala contributiva de trabajadores independientes y asegurados voluntarios, Seguro de Salud

excerpt.to: Nivel de Ingreso Seguro de IVM

excerpt.from: ACUERDO PRIMERO: Establecer la siguiente escala
excerpt.to: (1) Adicionalmente la contribución del Estado como tal es de 0.25% en el Seguro de Salud

excerpt.from: ACUERDO SEGUNDO: Encargar a la Gerencia Financiera

documents.notes: Salud rates by income bracket (afiliado 2.89–10.69%, conjunta 12.00% + 0.25% Estado como tal), still vigente — the 2026 adjustment touched IVM only (see ccss-escala-ivm). Same acuerdo SINALEVI carries as an image in ccss-bmc; the acta transcribes the table as text. Page-ranged because the full acta is 170 pages of unrelated Junta Directiva business — re-verify the range if CCSS re-publishes the acta. Deep link page (#134): chips land on page 105, the first page of the ingested range and the page the vigente escala sits on. The range was 104–108 until #198: page 104 carries only Tabla N°1 (afiliado counts, not rates) and the head of the superseded Tabla N°2, none of which survives the excerpt, so a chip that landed there pointed at content the corpus does not hold. EXCERPT (#198), THREE slices, because the claim this document makes is not contiguous. Pages 104–108 carry four tables and no page cut separates them: Tabla N°2 «Escala contributiva vigente hasta el 30 de setiembre de 2018» straddles the 104/105 break, and the vigente Salud escala sits on 105 beside its tail. Slice 1 («2. Propuesta de ajuste» → the IVM table's header) keeps the vigente Salud escala and its three notes, and drops Tabla N°1 and Tabla N°2 whole — with them the interleaved header («Conjunt Afiliad … a o Estado Conjunta», two labels split mid-word across physical lines) and the «104 N° 8999» page furniture pdftotext leaves between its categories 2 and 3. Slice 2 picks the operative ACUERDO PRIMERO back up. Slice 3 runs ACUERDO SEGUNDO → ARTICULO 31°, so the acuerdos arrive whole and the unrelated MIPYMES artículo below them does not. IVM DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED (#198, #150), and that is what costs the second and third slice. This document is the Salud escala; ccss-escala-ivm owns IVM, and no IVM figure should reach a reader from here. Two of them had to be cut, not one. (a) The 2018 IVM escala between slices 1 and 2: legible and dated, but its 8.92% conjunta was replaced by 9.91% effective 2026-01-01. (b) The «Notas» block under ACUERDO PRIMERO, between slices 2 and 3, whose note (1) reads «0.25% en el Seguro de Salud y 1.24% Seguro de IVM» — the Estado-como-tal figure, since raised to 1.75%. Cutting it costs nothing: the identical Salud-only note («la contribución del Estado como tal es de 0.25%») is already in slice 1, so the 0.25% this document is cited for survives, and only the stale IVM half is gone. Both figures are true of 2018 and neither is disqualified by anything inside this acta — «vigencia a partir del 01 de octubre del 2018» is a start date, and a 2018 acuerdo cannot announce its own supersession. Retrieval ranks on text, not on effective_date, and the answer prompt is forbidden from preferring a source merely for being newer, so a stale figure that reaches the model becomes a reported conflict rather than a wrong answer — on a question the corpus can answer outright. If historical questions ever enter scope, the 2018 IVM escala belongs in its own dated document, not inside this chunk. THE ACUERDO CARRIES NO TABLE (#114): ACUERDO PRIMERO's own escala is a raster image — the text runs straight from «…ajustes en los sistemas informáticos.» to «Notas:». Every rate here is therefore quoted from the propuesta section slice 1 keeps, never from the acuerdo body; narrowing to the acuerdo alone would empty the document of rates. NOT layoutTable (#179): tested against this document and findLayoutGrid returns null for every column count — the Salud table's wrapped rows («Más de 0.9295 SM a 4.33% / menos de 2 SM») change the column count line to line, so no run of lines agrees on a grid. Before the excerpt the only grid it found was the IVM table's header plus two rows, so opting in would have relabelled the wrong table. Opting in now fails ingestion rather than improving it. RESIDUE: category 2 keeps its rate spliced into its own bracket text, which the «%» signs (Tabla N°2 had none) keep unambiguous; ACUERDO CUARTO keeps «107 N° 8999» inside a sentence, where the page break falls — prose, not a data row; and slice 2 ends on the orphan word «Notas:», the heading of the block cut for its 1.24%. SURVEY (#199): no rail. Its escala tables are data grids, and labelRail reads those as rails and mangles them, so this document is deliberately left unflagged. SURVEY (#203): no stacked formula — the acuerdos and their escalas carry rates, not expressions. Not flagged.
